dedupe_keys.name: power plant integration and optimisation of climate neutral energy resources p2ioneer

description: Power Plant Integration and Optimisation of climate NEutral Energy Resources (P2IONEER) is a model listed in Open Energy Platform model and framework factsheets, a public register of energy-system model and framework factsheets under the section "Models", published or maintained by Zentrum für Sonnenenergie- und Wasserstoff-Forschung Baden-Württemberg (ZSW). Finding the lowest LCOE for the complete system for a given renewable fraction and a certain location including sector coupling and water desalination if applicable for the given location. Coverage: not restricted to one place on the factsheet. Time resolution: hour, 15 min, 1 min. Spatial resolution: national states, TSO regions, federal states, regions, NUTS 3, municipalities, districts, households, power stations. Software: only Python standard packages. The listed link gives the source code or documentation; nothing was downloaded or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the factsheet. Caveats: this record was written from the Open Energy Platform factsheet only, so the code, documentation and any publication it links were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the factsheet may lag the project. It can support energy-system planning and scenario studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oep-factsheet-catalogue.
